utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I’m bringing cookies to Mara’s book club. I’ll be there too—can’t forget this time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, thanks for the reminder—next Thursday at Mara’s place, right? I’ll try to bring a snack if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, next Thursday at Mara’s place. I’ll bring the cookies, and I’m glad you might come too!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I still have some tea and snacks left for book club, and everyone should bring a snack if they can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out by the door for Uli’s book club details. I might bring something too if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be great, thanks — and if Uli’s note says mystery night, let me know so I can be ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m free next Thursday evening for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, next Thursday works for the book club. We’re reading a mystery novel next, so it should be a fun one.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Rosa’s helping choose the next book, and I’m still organizing things on my end. Oren said he’ll bring the cookies, so we’ve got that covered.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great — I’m looking forward to book club. Let me know if you need any help with the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — I might take you up on that if anything comes up. I’ll keep you posted as the details get sorted.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we reading the same book this week? I want to confirm the title before I tell Pia the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — it’s the same book, and Vik said he’d remind everyone it’s on Thursday with their pick. I’ll bring a couple easy snacks and a discussion question.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — just to confirm, we’re still on Thursday, right? And what place are we meeting at?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I can swing by if Rey wants, and after the first meeting I’ll compare notes with them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Thursday works for me. I’ll have the book ready, and Quinn will send the details over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Thursday it is — I’ll wait for Quinn’s details and then I’ll swing by if Rey wants.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — after I finish my errands, I’ll send Bo the book and the time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — just make sure Bo knows we’re meeting at the community center and keep the time handy.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll let Bo know it’s at the community center and send the time once I’m done with errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I picked The Night Circus for this month. I’ll drop the details by Noah’s door so he can keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’m still waiting on the book and time. I’ll keep an eye out for Ira’s note after errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll leave the note by Noah’s door soon, so Ira can grab the details after errands. The Night Circus should be a fun one.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check the school calendar and get back to Leo soon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, that helps. I’ll wait to hear back, and maybe I can ask Gus about that mystery novel too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll check the calendar and let Leo know soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thursday works for the book club—what does everyone think? Don’t forget to bring your pick, and if you want to host next time, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thursday works for me. I’ll bring a couple of ideas, and if hosting next time helps, I’m happy to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks Rosa — I’ll let Ira know what everyone says, and I’ll check who wants to host next time too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oh good — is Sam planning to come to book club this week?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep, Eli’s coming too. I’ll send everyone the details and a quick invite, and Thursday at my place should work.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — Thursday at your place works for me. Please send the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday at Quinn’s place could work if the invite goes out soon, but I’d like Kira to confirm the time and place first before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll borrow The Midnight Library from Gus and catch up before Thursday. Then I can confirm once Kira sends the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me — I’m happy to wait for Kira’s confirmation before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, nice — if Gus’s copy comes in, I’d be happy to borrow it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me — if Quinn sends the invite soon, Thursday at Quinn’s place still sounds fine. I’m happy to wait for Kira to confirm the time and place before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good to me — I can wait for Kira to confirm too. And if Tess wants to swing by, that’d be fine.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: The book club’s mystery pick is supposed to have a pretty good twist. If you want, I can bring my spare copy of "The Midnight Library" for Dane tonight too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are we definitely reading "The Midnight Library" this week? If Hana can confirm the title, I can tell Pia the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No, the club’s next pick is the mystery novel — "The Midnight Library" is just the spare copy I’m lending Dane tonight. If Hana confirms the title, go ahead and tell Pia the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — if Rey wants, I can swing by, and we can compare notes after that first meeting.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds great, Tess — I’ll bring a couple easy snacks and a discussion question for us.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — that sounds like a cozy start. Tell Rey I’m happy to swing by and compare notes after the first meeting.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check the book club title first, and then I’ll confirm it for you.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — it’s for Thursday, and I’ll ask what everyone thinks, remind folks to bring their pick, and check who wants to host next time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’m just verifying the title now, and then I’ll confirm it for you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sam’s looking forward to book club this week—are we still meeting on Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, Thursday still works. I’m running errands now, but I’ll send Bo the book and time after I’m done.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks—can you also let me know if anything changes?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’ll watch by the door for the book club details. Thanks, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Noah — I’ll borrow Gus’s spare copy of "The Midnight Library" and catch up before Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll still keep an eye by the door for the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check the school calendar and get back to Leo soon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks — I’ll send everyone the details and a quick invite for Thursday at my place. Eli’s in too, so we should have a nice turnout.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll confirm after I check the school calendar.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Rosa’s helping pick the next book, and Oren’s bringing the cookies. I’m glad we’ve got the book club pieces covered.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I picked The Night Circus for this month. I can drop the details by Noah’s door so he can keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great — thanks, Uli. Drop it by Noah’s door, and I’ll make sure everyone’s looped in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thursday works for me—I’ll be there with the book ready. I’ll wait for Quinn’s details and invite.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Thursday works for me too. I’m looking forward to it, and I’ll keep an eye out for Quinn’s details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—Thursday it is, and I’ll be there with the book ready. We can wait for Quinn’s details and go from there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, great — next Thursday at Mara’s place, right? I’ll bring a snack if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can make next Thursday evening. Just waiting on Faye to check the school schedule before we confirm.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — thanks for the update. I’ll wait for Faye’s confirmation too, and I’ll bring a snack if I make it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That mystery novel sounds like a great pick for book club — I’ll check the library copy on Maple Street and help get us set up. Mara’s helping too, so we should have everything organized soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll keep everyone posted on the meeting place and the plan. Thanks for checking the Maple Street library copy!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: You’re welcome, Opal — I’ll follow up on the library copy and keep you posted. We’ll have the book club ready in no time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I’ll bring the cookies to Mara’s book club. I’m looking forward to it!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’m still waiting on the book and time from Ira after errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No worries — I’ll keep an eye out for Ira’s book and time too. See you at Mara’s book club!

injected.text: Update: the book club has been moved from Tuesday at the library to Thursday at the cafe.
